results.title: The 2025 Foundation Model Transparency Index
results.snippet: Foundation model developers are among the world's most important companies. As these companies become increasingly consequential, how do their transparency practices evolve? The 2025 Foundation Model Transparency Index is the third edition of an annual effort to characterize and quantify the transparency of foundation model developers. The 2025 FMTI introduces new indicators related to data acquisition, usage data, and monitoring and evaluates companies like Alibaba, DeepSeek, and xAI for the first time. The 2024 FMTI reported that transparency was improving, but the 2025 FMTI finds this prog…

results.title: VQualA 2025 Challenge on Engagement Prediction for Short Videos: Methods and Results
results.snippet: This paper presents an overview of the VQualA 2025 Challenge on Engagement Prediction for Short Videos, held in conjunction with ICCV 2025. The challenge focuses on understanding and modeling the popularity of user-generated content (UGC) short videos on social media platforms. To support this goal, the challenge uses a new short-form UGC dataset featuring engagement metrics derived from real-world user interactions. This objective of the Challenge is to promote robust modeling strategies that capture the complex factors influencing user engagement. Participants explored a variety of multi-mo…

results.title: GEM-4D: Geometry-Enhanced Video World Models for Robot Manipulation
results.snippet: Video world models can generate realistic futures from a single instruction, but they often fail to track the same physical points consistently across time. As a result, the generated videos appear plausible, yet lack the physical grounding required for reliable action execution, such as robot manipulation. We present GEM-4D, a geometry-grounded video world model that resolves this limitation by injecting dense 4D correspondence supervision distilled from a pretrained geometry foundation model into the video generative backbone during training. This supervision enables the model to jointly ca…

results.title: Technical Report for ICRA 2025 GOOSE 3D Semantic Segmentation Challenge: Adaptive Point Cloud Understanding for Heterogeneous Robotic Systems
results.snippet: This technical report presents the implementation details of the winning solution for the ICRA 2025 GOOSE 3D Semantic Segmentation Challenge. This challenge focuses on semantic segmentation of 3D point clouds from diverse unstructured outdoor environments collected from multiple robotic platforms. This problem was addressed by implementing Point Prompt Tuning (PPT) integrated with Point Transformer v3 (PTv3) backbone, enabling adaptive processing of heterogeneous LiDAR data through platform-specific conditioning and cross-dataset class alignment strategies. The model is trained without requir…

findings.point: GEM-4D 提出了一种几何增强的视频世界模型，解决了现有视频世界模型在时间上无法一致跟踪同一物理点的问题，为机器人操作提供了物理 grounding。
findings.evidence: 论文指出视频世界模型虽能生成逼真未来帧，但常无法在时间上一致跟踪同一物理点，导致缺乏可靠动作执行所需的物理 grounding；GEM-4D 通过几何 grounding 解决此限制。

results.title: Xiaomi-Robotics-1: Scaling Vision-Language-Action Models with over 100K Hours of Real-World Trajectories
results.snippet: We present Xiaomi-Robotics-1, a foundational vision-language-action (VLA) model capable of (1) following diverse language instructions to perform a wide range of mobile manipulation tasks in unseen environments out-of-the-box, and (2) efficiently adapting to novel downstream tasks with minimal fine-tuning data. We propose a two-stage training recipe consisting of pre-training and post-training. During pre-training, we imbue the model with broad and generalizable action-generation capabilities by training on over 100k hours of real-world manipulation trajectories collected via UMI devices. By combining foundation models with the principles of embodied AI, where intelligent systems perceive, reason, and act through physical interaction, mobile service robots can achieve more flexible understanding, adaptive behavior, and robust task execution in dynamic real-world environments. We present a method for learning to navigate, to a fixed goal and in a known environment, on a mobile robot. results.title: DECOWAM: Decoupled Whole-Body World-Action Model for Legged Mobile Manipulation
results.snippet: Mobile manipulation requires a robot to predict how locomotion and arm motion jointly alter future observations and control. Existing world-action models, developed largely for fixed-base platforms, do not explicitly distinguish camera ego-motion from base and arm actions. Here we introduce DECOWAM, a whole-body world-action model that separates these factors through dedicated conditional interfaces. # 机器人操作与世界模型：前沿追踪报告（2024-2026）

**日期**：2026-11-07（UTC） | **领域**：具身智能 / 机器人操作 / 世界模型 / VLA / ROS2 工程落地 | **检索源数量**：31 条（其中机器人相关有效源 14 条）

---

## 1. 进展与热点

### 1.1 核心增量判断
近 1-2 年，**世界模型从“视频生成”向“几何一致的物理 grounding”转型**，且 **VLA 基础模型进入“10 万小时真机数据”规模化阶段**；两大方向在 2025-2026 年同步出现标志性工作，但**真机闭环验证仍为稀缺证据** [15][2][20][22]。

### 1.2 关键进展条目

### 1.3 热点聚类

## 3. 蓝海与缺口

### 3.1 核心增量判断
**“几何一致的世界模型 + 闭环真机控制”**、**“跨本体统一动作空间的 VLA”**、**“ROS2 原生大模型推理管线”** 三大方向**无成熟开源方案、无统一基准、无工程标准**，属高杠杆蓝海。

### 3.2 结构化缺口清单

| 缺口方向 | 具体描述 | 证据来源 | 优先级 |
|----------|----------|----------|--------|
| 视频世界模型的长时序几何一致性 | 现有视频世界模型无法在时间上一致跟踪同一物理点，缺乏可靠动作执行所需的物理 grounding [15] | [15] | ★★★★★ |
| 世界模型生成帧与真实物理动力学的对齐 | 生成的未来帧在视觉上逼真但物理上可能不一致（穿模、漂移、能量不守恒） | [15][20][22] | ★★★★★ |
| 从视频预测到闭环机器人控制的可靠性桥接 | 世界模型作为 planner/policy 的前向模型时，误差累积、分布外泛化、实时性均无成熟解法 | [15][27][19] | ★★★★★ |
| 跨本体统一动作空间与 Tokenization | 不同本体（机械臂/灵巧手/移动/腿式/人形）的动作空间统一表示、离散化粒度、时序对齐无共识 | [2][25][22] | ★★★★☆ |
| ROS2/C++ 原生大模型推理管线 | VLA/世界模型推理（PyTorch/ONNX/TensorRT）与 ROS2 实时控制回路（微秒/毫秒级）的工程集成缺乏最佳实践与标准库 | [26] | ★★★★☆ |
| 真机大规模数据采集与标注工程化 | 10 万小时级数据的采集硬件、同步、标注、清洗、版本管理、隐私合规无开源工业级流水线 | [2][16] | ★★★★☆ |
| 长时域任务的语义-几何联合推理 | 语言指令→子任务分解→几何感知→运动生成的端到端可验证链路缺失 | [19][27] | ★★★★☆ |
| 安全关键场景的世界模型不确定性量化 | 世界模型预测的不确定性（aleatoric/epistemic）如何映射为安全控制器的约束条件无标准范式 | [15][20][22] | ★★★★☆ |

> 待核实：上述缺口综合自现有文献显性讨论的局限 [15][2][26][19][27]，**未覆盖所有潜在子领域（如触觉-视觉联合世界模型、柔性物体操作世界模型等）**，需进一步检索补全。

## 4. 瓶颈与拐点

### 4.1 核心增量判断
**数据规模与真机验证的“双瓶颈”正在逼近拐点**：数据侧，头部厂商已突破 10 万小时真机轨迹 [2]，但**长尾任务、罕见事件、跨环境泛化数据仍稀缺**；验证侧，**缺乏统一的真机基准协议与第三方审计机制**，导致 SOTA 宣称难以比较。拐点信号：**若出现“开源 10 万小时级数据集 + 统一真机评测协议 + 多机构独立复现报告”三件套**，将标志性进入“可比较工程阶段”。
